title: CorporateLeadReferred
description: A provider referred a company to Kiorex as an enterprise lead (Clinic to Kiorex). Company name, an optional size bucket and an opaque contact reference only: never a staff member's name, phone or e-mail, never a patient datum. No fee share or reward is created by this event (work package P4-C; any fee share is counsel and CEO gated).

orgRef.description: Organisation (tenant) reference that owns the link code; the same value the signed `lt` carries as `o`. Additive in 1.11.0 on ReferralLinkCreated (optional there); required on ReferralLinkRevoked.

contactRef.description: Opaque reference held by the referring provider; Kiorex ops asks the provider for the contact. Never a name, phone or e-mail.

aggregateType.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.

aggregateId.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.
